name: SmartPaddle C4 mainboard to tail-board adapter harness

routing.usbPair: usb_dp and usb_dn twisted together inside signal bundle
routing.strainRelief: heat-shrink both 4-wire breakouts; retain each housing latch; lace the two trunk branches together 15-25 mm from the main-board connectors, leaving a service loop toward the tail board
routing.keepOut: Do not cross the tail-board ring groove, PCB slot edge, or any layer 2->1 / layer 3->4 screw envelope

conductors.function: switched 5 V return for tail LED

intentionallyUnconnectedMainPins.disposition: labelled main-board test lead only; do not populate in tail harness
labelled main-board test lead only; do not populate in tail harness

assemblyOrder: Install and electrically test the tail board before closing the handle.
Crimp and continuity-test J2 power branch and J3 signal branch separately.
Insert the two 5-pin main-board housings with UART cavities left empty and individually sealed/labelled.
Route power on -X and signal on +X; keep the USB pair twisted through the free span.
Mate the main-board connectors first, seat the main board, then mate the tail board and seat it in the ring groove.
Form the service loop and laced Y-junction without loading either PCB connector, then close layers 3 and 4.
